verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference provider, so asynchronous batch jobs at a discount are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence lists only Chat Completions, Responses, speech to text and Anthropic Messages APIs, with no batch or async job API. A per-service-tier price mention is not evidence of a batch discount.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
